brief:
The European Commission is reviewing a popular initiative that gathered 1.1 million signatures from 12 countries calling for suspension of its partnership agreement with Israel over alleged human rights violations, Shehab Wire reported.

The initiative represents one of the largest citizen-led petitions directed at the Brussels-based body on the Middle East issue. The Commission's response will determine whether the partnership framework faces formal review or potential suspension.
